sites.source: Campspot availability 2027-06-08: 9 electric-only (01-09, Pull-Through, 50-93 ft), 14 water & electric (10, 13-25, 42-67 ft), 2 ADA water & electric (11-12), 8 premium water & electric (31-38, 40-80 ft), 8 primitive (101-108, 50-77 ft) = 41; read 2026-11-04

values.note: Online at Campspot or by phone with the Buffalo County Facilities Office (M-F 8-5). Drive-up camping on any site not reserved, paid in the lock box at the entrances within an hour of arrival; reservations take precedence.

booking.source: Campspot park record, Terms & Conditions: 'Reservations are accepted up to 1 year in advance of the arrival date ... Phone reservations can be made with the Buffalo County Facilities Office Monday-Friday 8am -5pm at (308)236-1225. Advanced reservations must be made at least 48 hours prior to arrival. Drive up camping is available when sites are not already reserved in advance, on a first come, first serve basis.'; 'Maximum Days : 10'; read 2026-11-04

note: Buffalo County park, the former Ravenna Lake State Recreation Area, turned over to the county about 20 years ago, so no Nebraska park permit is needed. Narrow, curving lake; paddle or electric trolling motors only, no swimming. Bathhouse by the pavilion (opened spring 2022). --Claude
summary: Campspot park record and site list read: county-run (legal name Buffalo County), 41 sites (9 electric-only pull-throughs, 16 water+electric incl. 2 ADA, 8 premium water+electric, 8 primitive), 40-130 ft, booking up to 1 year out until 48 h before arrival, drive-up on unreserved sites, 10-day max. Hookups, sites and booking now manual. Fees left (Campspot read 2026-10-13). Lakefront kept on the park's own map plus imagery.
